```{r,warning = F, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(reactable)

schedule <- read.csv("./docs/adit/DRSN_Events_2026.csv")
schedule_subset <- schedule[-1, c("Date","Event", "Speaker", "Event.time")]

htmltools::browsable(
tbl <- reactable(
  schedule_subset,
          defaultColDef = colDef(
            align = "left",
            headerStyle = list(background = "#FFDBBB")
          ),

  # Define columns
  columns = list(
    Date = colDef("Date", width = 100),
    Time = colDef("Event.time", width = 100),
    Speaker = colDef("Speaker", width = 150),
    Event = colDef("Event", width = 300, filterable = TRUE)
  ),

  # Other table features
  searchable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  theme = reactableTheme(
    searchInputStyle = list(width = "20%"),
    borderColor = "#813401"
  )
)
)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(tbl, "./docs/0_schedule.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```
